intro: A premium destination with zero income tax and a residence visa via a Free Zone company. Dubai is the main hub.
climate: Tropical desert — hot summers up to +45°C and a warm, mild winter. High humidity by the sea.
mentality: A multicultural society where 90% of residents are expats. An English-speaking environment everywhere; respect for local traditions is essential.
language_note: Arabic is the official language. English is effectively the main language of business and daily life.
visa_note: 60 days on arrival for Russians. A residence visa via an employer, a Free Zone company ($5,000+/year) or a Golden Visa.
